description:
Goal: collapse the runtime/prelude/preamble naming and the two predicates is_runtime_prelude and is_runtime_module_code (world.rs:1995, 1999) into one is_bootstrap(code) concept, used at the single decision site in index_code (jobs/source.rs:33). Keep the bootstrap-prelude-as-namespace-base role (the scope_code special-case that seeds prelude_head) as a separately named fact: origin is not role.

Grounding: index_code selects the canonical surface reader via is_runtime_prelude(code) || is_runtime_module_code(code); the OR is the smell that two predicates name one concept. prelude/preamble/runtime appear as scattered synonyms across world.rs and friends.

Signal: one predicate is_bootstrap; the namespace-base role retains its own distinct name; full lib green with zero warnings; no behavior change.

Strategy: pure consolidation and rename, no logic change. Blocks fz-rh2.28.2.
title: Compiler2 bootstrap boundary: name it once
